stops.title: Wetin dɛn de Ripɔt
stops.caption: Atɛndans, groth, ɛngejmɛnt.
stops.speech: Ripɔt kɔva atɛndans trɛnd, mɛmbaship groth, ɛngejmɛnt ɛn awtrich, ɛvri wan insay wetin yu rol kin si.

stops.title: Chenj di Tɛm
stops.caption: Di las mɔnt, ɔ di las ia.
stops.speech: Chenj di tɛm fɔ mek am big ɔ smɔl. Di nɔmba dɛn ɛn ɛvri chat de fɔlo am.
